item.title: Passenger records exposed, browser backdoors and Adobe's urgent fix
item.description:
An exposed passenger database held 220 million records, while Grindr has agreed to settle UK claims over sensitive data sharing. Adobe patches the actively exploited Commerce and Magento flaw, and new critical vulnerabilities put SAP services, Siemens protection devices and Hitachi application servers on the change queue.
